    Theorem 11.7(1)(2) in characteristic two #

    The source paper (thm:final-basis). For a basic representation-finite algebra in characteristic two, Proposition 8.3 (exists_normedRayBasis_basic_char2), with Corollary 10.5 now proved (cor105Hyp), gives a normed multiplicative ray transversal for one complete set of primitive idempotents; conjugation (exists_algEquiv_idempotents) moves it to any other (exists_rayTransversal_of_algEquiv).
